name: Patrice Stanzione
office: Bassett Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Patrice Stanzione is a Governing Board Member for the Bassett Unified School District and a special education teacher. She says she has taught students from kindergarten through 12th grade, including special education and gifted programs, for over four and a half decades. Stanzione first served on the board as an appointee from July 2014 to December 2015 and was elected in 2018.

items.text: She says the board's main duties include setting the district's vision and monitoring the budget to focus on student achievement. In 2019, she was one of two board members who voted against rehiring a contractor that had past conflicts with school districts.
